phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A0 — source-structure assessment

findings.finding: Where the required W0 components are published, F2 reconciles to F21 + F2M and, where F22/F29 are also published, to F21 + F22 + F29 within 0.1 million RON.
findings.implication: F2M is a deposit component of F2, not a substitute for total F2.

findings.finding: The tested domestic who-to-whom deposit relations are published from the issuer liability side using F2M, including S12K/S12T/S12/S121/S13 issuer-sector variants.
findings.implication: The later deposit submatrix audit must orient canonical holder-to-issuer cells from issuer liabilities rather than mechanically reuse the F3 asset-side convention.

findings.finding: The tested domestic bilateral issuer-side families publish F2M deposits but not bilateral F21 currency or total F2 at the same holder/issuer granularity.
findings.implication: A complete F2 holder-by-issuer matrix cannot yet be claimed from QSA alone. Currency must be solved as a separate official-data identification problem.

findings.finding: Direct W0 F2 controls are available for the relevant resident sectors tested and can be used to reconcile any later deposit-plus-currency construction.
findings.implication: Aggregate totals remain controls and must not be converted into bilateral allocations.

prohibited_inferences: Do not assign all resident F21 currency holdings to BNR merely because BNR issues Romanian currency.
Do not ignore foreign-currency holdings embedded in F21 assets.
Do not relabel F2M deposits as total F2.
Do not allocate an aggregate currency residual across holder sectors by shares, proportions or balancing.
Do not promote any F2 benchmark cell from this source-structure probe.

next_gate.name: F2 Deposit Submatrix Coverage Audit
next_gate.scope: Audit F2M holder-by-issuer positions and 2025 transactions using issuer-liability QSA publication, exact RMD sector mappings and W0/W1 reconciliation controls.
next_gate.parallel_open_question: Search official BNR/ECB/Eurostat sources for a defensible sector-by-issuer allocation of F21 currency. If unavailable, record non-identifiability rather than inventing allocation.
